manifest.strictFields: Exact mandatory fields; optional completedPlan and completedIntent occur together. Validate every checkpoint archive/epoch, pin shape/aggregate budget, pending plan and historical completed intent source/targets.
manifest.generationRace: Before each phase and unlink, reload actual manifest and require the expected semantic hash/generation/root binding. A replacement cannot be overwritten silently by an old local state.
manifest.completedIntent: Final manifest stores the exact completed intent including operationToken. Explicit recovery after intent removal and before lock cleanup can reuse only this durable plan, never synthesize source facts.
manifest.duplicateKeys: Manager metadata rejects duplicate JSON keys. Hashes are not authentication against arbitrary replacement of every file.

failureMarker.name: operation-failed.json
failureMarker.failure: Attempt a bounded marker only after owned mutating work fails. The synchronized operation.lock predates it and remains even if marker IO also fails. Non-owner calls cannot clear dirty state or poison the owner.
failureMarker.recovery: Check any marker before unlink, then compare identical marker bytes before removal. Foreign/unreadable/changed markers refuse recovery; only fully verified explicit recovery clears an owned marker.

resourceChecks.sharedMeter: Adoption and subsequent phases share one operation budget, including manifest/index/fence reads, writes and conservative raw-reader pass work. Failure marker is a fixed-size emergency attempt that never releases the existing guard.
resourceChecks.preflight: Stream physical segment counts/hashes without a full-log list before raw JSON/lifecycle decode. Cutoff/root counts are bounded before JSON allocation or mutation locks.
resourceChecks.tests: Small actual files cross scaled configured caps. No 32MiB/16k-event stress or OS disk/CPU hard-quota claim. Actual temporary occupancy checked before publication.

execution.environment: Create a dedicated temporary base; set MTW_JOURNAL_SCRATCH, TEMP and TMP. Runner creates unique children and preserves evidence; no database.
execution.windowsDanglingSymlinkCases: Original two skips remain not executed. Linux independent CI may check corresponding original cases separately without changing old receipts.
execution.remainingGate: Independent execution, syntax/runtime validation, revision regression and adversarial review before promotion.
